situation.unavailable: No direct self lifetime-XP field in current BASIC HeroDataNames. Full replay XP/drought counters must never become controller inputs.

proposed_predicates.wave_xp_reachable: Visible living enemy creep on selfLayer with a navigable approach into six-tile XP radius.
proposed_predicates.unsafe_hero_chase: Selected hero outside practical melee reach, no plausible immediate finish, and chase would leave reachable wave or enter stronger enemy/tower pressure.
proposed_predicates.income_access_missing: No visible enemy creep within XP radius for a bounded observation-memory interval; this is a public opportunity proxy, not measured personal XP.
proposed_predicates.basic_hit_committed: Self target remains valid and basic attack windup is close to impact; retain it until a hit, target disappearance or urgent escape.
proposed_predicates.safe_wave_edge: Navigable same-floor point within6tiles of a visible enemy creep, on the allied side relative to nearby enemy heroes; incoming danger and tower target checks pass.

verified_class_geometry.evidence: Pinned fd315c8 content.nim HeroSpecs/ItemSpecs; sim.nim hero initialization. Current captured DeathKnight buys110gold dagger then30gold health potion. Item names do not imply ranged attacks.

survival_alone.claim: Broad melee survival bundles reduced Berserker deaths while lowering native XP. First complete blue-late50/source hosted comparison also lowers deaths but drops mean score146.52 to84.66. Full400game gate and all diagnostics remain separate.

income_access.claim: Predeclared outcome-blind blue-late replay sample shows long healthy field XP droughts and scarce sampled creep-XP proximity despite increased explicit self-healing. This motivates route/target changes, not proof of their competitive benefit.

belief.attribution_limit: The tested bundle changes unlocks, healing, spacing and creep spell budgeting together. Do not attribute its score effect to any single component without a separate intervention.

chase_geometry.claim: Vanguard/DeathKnight have substantially less basic reach and movement speed than Ranger. Boots increase movement but do not make either class faster than same-level unbooted Ranger. Repeated open-field pursuit needs a credible closing/finish opportunity; equipment value needs a joint route/target test.

goal.score: Increase overall mean XP-minus200perminute score, nonzero conditional mean and productive frequency.
goal.survival: Reduce avoidable deaths while retaining or increasing XP per minute. Fewer deaths with lower XP is insufficient.

FarmAtSafeWaveEdge.initiation: wave_xp_reachable and enemy pressure makes direct melee unsafe
FarmAtSafeWaveEdge.operation: Select a navigable allied-side wave point inside XP radius; observe danger there, use useful recovery, and take brief in-range last-hit opportunities. Avoid an unconditional home trip or permanent standstill.
FarmAtSafeWaveEdge.termination: Wave dies/leaves, enemies threaten the point, health requires escape, shopping becomes worthwhile or a high-value finish opens.

RejectUnproductiveChase.operation: Before attackTarget on a distant hero, compare a reachable wave and local danger. Prefer recurring wave XP unless an affordable short kill is plausible. Do not retreat indefinitely simply because an enemy is visible.

ProtectBasicLastHit.operation: Preserve a nearly completed basic windup against a lethal creep; do not retarget or walk merely because another target marginally outranks it. Urgent survival overrides; clear state after hit/target loss.

PendingSpellBudget.operation: Track accepted lethal creep spell target/expected impact briefly across decisions, not just within one decision, to avoid subsequent overcasts while a projectile travels. Bound the memory and cancel if target disappears or circumstances change.

MeleeMobilityKit.operation: Compare a100gold boots plus30gold potion opening with current110gold dagger plus30gold potion; test positioning/escape and lost early damage together. Coordinate later core-item selection, six inventory slots, shopping intent and buyback completion tests so substituted gear does not cause endless restocking or disabled buyback. Do not assume Rune Crossbow increases melee range.
MeleeMobilityKit.gate: Fresh class-stratified full games; score, XP/minute, deaths/minute and reach/creep-access diagnostics, preserving unaffected classes.

strategy.when: basic_hit_committed and not imminent lethal danger

execution.scope: Follow-up proposals only; no source edits to the running frozen400game comparison.
